issue.body:
Addressing #154890

Not really a proper fix but at least it's more informative than the current crash.

For a more long term solution I'm testing if we can use the TopK API released in MacOS14 as it does not have the same MPSScan op issue that the Sort and ArgSort are hitting.

body:
This goes down a similar path to cumulative sum as Sort and ArgSort APIs call into the MPSScan kernel under the hood. Added a PR https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/155475 to address the immediate issue of ugly crashing by asserting the conditions where the error would be raised.

For a more long term solution I'm looking into we can move the op to use the TopK and BottomK APIs released in MacOS14 since they do not run into the same issue.

issue.body:
Fixes #154890 for MacOS14+ and adds an assert with clearer error message for earlier OSs.

Additionally since the torch.topk spec* does not guarantee stable sort for tied indices (and neither does MPS topk) I removed the check for the index array matching for topk op in the test cases and removed the xfails that were caused by unreasonably expecting stable sort. So for topk we only verify the value array contains the same values in the same order as the CPU reference.

*https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.7/generated/torch.topk.html
